description: React component for a user guide dropdown menu in Mattermost, including links to documentation, training resources, community ask, report problem, and keyboard shortcuts modal.

classes.name: UserGuideDropdown
classes.description: React component class for the user guide dropdown menu, managing state and rendering menu items with links and actions.

methods.name: openKeyboardShortcutsModal
methods.description: Opens the keyboard shortcuts modal dialog.

methods.name: buttonToggleState
methods.description: Toggles the active state of the button/menu.

methods.name: renderDropdownItems
methods.description: Renders the list of menu items including links and actions.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component JSX including tooltip, icon button, and menu.
